security.item: Quick Upload now validates its security token before accepting a package
Uploaded filenames containing a second extension (such as .php.zip) are now rejected
Release storage folder is now protected on Apache 2.4, nginx and IIS

fix.item: Release edit screen: uploading a replacement ZIP failed with "File not uploaded for security reasons!" on Joomla 6, and saved without the file on Joomla 5
Update XML used an incorrect extension element, so client sites were never offered updates
Download button plugin was installed disabled instead of enabled
Uninstalling the component deleted all uploaded release packages
Replacing a package no longer removes the existing file until the new upload succeeds
Downloads for a release with no package file returned an empty, broken file
Changelog shortcode failed when a feed contained no entries
Admin language file was installed into the site language folder

addition.item: Verified compatibility with Joomla 5 and Joomla 6 on PHP 8.1 through 8.4
Installing on an unsupported database now reports a clear error instead of completing with no tables

note.item: If any product was created through Quick Upload before this version, check its Element field on the Products page - earlier versions could save an incorrect value that stops updates reaching your customers

fix.item: CSS framework not inherited when navigating from Products to Releases view
Back to Products button not using SEF links with proper Itemid
Protected products blocking downloads for logged-in users with valid access levels
Joomla access levels not enforced for non-protected product downloads

addition.item: product_id option for changelog shortcode to read URL from latest Release record
Add {jreleaser logged-in-user="show" copy="show"} shortcode to display user's master API key
Add "Allow Guest Downloads" setting in Component Options

fix.item: Fix Releases menu routing losing style
Fix "Cannot access offset of type array" error on dedicated Releases menu items
Fix output="modified" shortcode option (uses release_created since releases are immutable)
Fix logged-in-user shortcode not working without product_id
Fix API key shortcode styling for better contrast on all themes
Fix guest downloads for non-protected products (403 error)
Use Route::_() for proper Joomla routing in Products and Releases templates

addition.item: Full API key viewing in backend - keys are now displayed in full with copy-to-clipboard button
Reset functionality for both master and site keys from the backend
Filters on API Keys page (key type, user, status, sorting options)
Download count sorting option on API Keys page

fix.item: Fixed untranslated filter dropdown labels showing raw language constants
Fixed download count sorting (was always sorting by date instead of download count)
Fixed SQL error "Unknown column r.modified" in download button plugin
Fixed user filter dropdown not populating with users

remove.item: Removed reference to non-existent modified column from releases query

addition.item: Additional download button shortcode options added
New download statistics in Download Log page
